groups.label: Difference 1 between light waves and sound waves
groups.diagnostic_hint: Light is TRANSVERSE and an electromagnetic wave; sound is LONGITUDINAL and a mechanical wave. Or: light can travel through a vacuum; sound cannot. Choose any one well-explained difference.

options.text: Light is transverse; sound is longitudinal
Light can travel through a vacuum; sound cannot
Light travels much faster than sound
Light is an electromagnetic wave; sound is a mechanical wave
Light and sound both travel through a vacuum
Light and sound travel at the same speed

groups.label: Difference 2 between light waves and sound waves (different from difference 1)
groups.diagnostic_hint: A second, distinct difference. Common choices: light travels at 3×10⁸ m/s, sound at ~340 m/s in air; light needs no medium, sound does; light is transverse, sound is longitudinal. Do not repeat your first answer.

ddwtos.word_bank_note: 6 tokens for 2 slots. 4 correct differences — any 2 of 4 earn full marks. 'Light and sound both travel through a vacuum' is false — sound requires a medium (vacuum = no medium = no sound). 'Light and sound travel at the same speed' is false — light is ~10⁶ times faster than sound (this is why lightning precedes thunder).
